info.name: Generate diagram from natural language prompt (AI)

items.docs: Generates a diagram from natural language or code input using AI. Supports a wide range of diagram types including flow charts, ERDs, sequence diagrams, cloud architecture diagrams, and BPMN diagrams.

info.name: Generate diagram from Eraser DSL code

items.docs: Generates a diagram image from Eraser DSL canvas elements. Use this endpoint when you have structured DSL code and want to render it into a PNG image or create an editable Eraser file.
